name: Custom Shape 2-Layer Wooden And Holographic Suncatcher
description:
KEY FEATURES

  • Premium Material:
    - Layer 1: Premium holographic acrylic (3 mm thickness), available in Starburst and Broken Glass styles, creating a stunning stained-glass effect when light passes through.
    - Layer 2: High-quality natural wood (3 mm thickness), laser-cut for precision and durability.
    - Comes with hanging accessories: suction cup,  black chain or silver chain for flexible display options.
    📌 Note: Broken Glass and Starburst acrylic have a slightly frosted appearance compared to transparent acrylic.

 

  • Sizes & Dimensions:

    8 x 8 inches ~ 20.32 x 20.32 cm
    9 x 9 inches ~ 22.86 x 22.86 cm
    12 x 12 inches ~ 30.48 x 30.48 cm

  • Printing Technology:
    - UV printing technology ensures vibrant colors, sharp details, and long-lasting image quality.
    - Single-sided printing, optimized for light interaction to enhance the holographic effect.

 

  • Function & Usage:
    - Designed to catch and reflect sunlight beautifully, creating eye-catching rainbow reflections.
    - Perfect for hanging on windows, glass doors, walls, porches, or cars.
    Adds warmth, personality, and artistic charm to any indoor or outdoor space.

 

  • Perfect Gift for Any Occasion: 
    - A thoughtful and meaningful gift suitable for all ages and all occasions, including birthdays, holidays, anniversaries, Mother’s Day, Father’s Day, Christmas, or simply as a personalized home décor piece.
    - Ideal for family members, friends, pet lovers, or anyone who appreciates unique and customized décor.

guideLine:
Print Guidelines

Below is our complete selection of art templates used for designing within the full printable area of our products. Each template comes with a .png detailing Safe Area, Bleed, etc. Download templates and mockups here

 

To use an Art Template:

  • Open the Printway template for your selected product in Photoshop or another design program.
  • Insert your artwork in a new layer, placing all important parts of your design within the designated “Safe zone” on the art template to ensure your design will not be cut off during the printing process.
  • If you’re designing drinkware, use the indicated centering lines to ensure your artwork is placed exactly where you’d like.
  • Hide or delete the Art Template layer from your file.
  • Save as a .png, .jpg, or another accepted file type.
  • You’ve now used a Printway template to create artwork exactly to the recommended specs for that product.

 

To ensure your design prints properly on each product:

  • Ensure all important elements of your design are within the safe zone on the product template.
  • Fill the entire design template! The outer edge of the template represents “Bleed Area,” which signifies the areas which may print on the outer edges of your product.
  • Failure to fill the bleed area will likely result in unprinted white unprinted areas around the edge of your product.
